reason: I try every new AI tool and keep maybe one in ten, and this would sit on the free plan at best. The on-site actions that make it worth paying for are on Pro, and I would not let an agent click and fill forms in front of my customers on a trial I have not compared on G2.
objection: An AI that clicks and acts on my site could do something wrong in front of my customers, like a wrong booking or a half-started checkout, and I do not see any guardrails or review reviews yet.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of guardrails (confirm-before-action, a log of every action, an off switch) plus real G2 or Capterra reviews from sites like mine.
